name: motion-design
title: Motion Design
description: Scroll motion, transitions, micro-interactions, hover systems, reveal animations and loading transitions that aid comprehension.
when_to_use: Interfaces that benefit from feedback and continuity; never as filler.
instructions: Each animation has a purpose (feedback, orientation, continuity); durations 120-400ms; standard easing tokens.
Animate transform and opacity only; no layout thrash; no scroll-jacking.
